description: A professional dermatologist-inspired nighttime skincare routine to address acne-prone skin, focusing on cleansing, exfoliating, treating existing blemishes, and protecting the skin while it repairs itself during sleep.
frequency: Once daily, typically at night before bed

night_steps.action: Cleansing with a gentle yet effective cleanser
night_steps.purpose: Remove dirt, oil, and makeup from the skin's surface without stripping its natural oils

night_steps.action: Exfoliating with a chemical exfoliant (if needed)
night_steps.purpose: Helps remove dead skin cells to reduce pore size and improve texture

night_steps.action: Applying an acne-fighting serum or treatment
night_steps.purpose: Target blemishes with ingredients that help prevent breakouts and reduce inflammation

night_steps.action: Using a hydrating but non-comedogenic moisturizer
night_steps.purpose: Lock in moisture without clogging pores, ensuring the skin is properly hydrated and ready for the next day

night_steps.action: Applying a broad-spectrum SPF (if used during the day)
night_steps.purpose: Protects against UV damage, which can exacerbate acne and lead to hyperpigmentation

common_mistakes: Over-exfoliating, which can irritate the skin and worsen acne

expected_results.2_weeks: Reduction in the number and size of existing blemishes, smoother skin texture, and an overall improvement in skin appearance.
expected_results.1_month: A noticeable decrease in new breakouts, improved skin tone, and potentially fewer blackheads and whiteheads.
expected_results.3_months: Long-term reduction in acne, clearer pores, and a more balanced skin barrier.

expert_tips: Always patch test new products to ensure compatibility with your skin type
Stay consistent with the routine for best results
